answer: The river graph is validated at intake and the timber frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and trellis anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 13 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 437 takes that multiplied out, plus 251 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
